Near-zero positive z makes1/w large when w=z; it does not make w large.
n=1 f=11 z=6 gives11/12 depth, not.5; viewport depth range differs from camera clipping distances.
Legacy w-buffer/float discussion is historical; ordinary float depth is not automatically uniformly precise. Current reversed-Z behavior depends on chosen depth convention/format.
Positive homogeneous matrix scaling does not change NDC; do not identify a projection solely from exact final row values across arbitrary equivalent matrices.
